theme_and_archetype.name: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) - Medical Premium Variant
theme_and_archetype.description: A high-end, trust-forward, and empathetic design system. Replaces the cold, clinical generic look with a premium 'concierge' aesthetic. Deep slate blues anchor the medical authority, warm bone-whites provide approachability, and WhatsApp Green is the solitary high-contrast highlight color optimized strictly for conversion.

critique_of_current_site: Lacks distinctive visual identity: The slate-blue and orange/yellow accent feels templated, diluting the perceived premium nature of Apollo Hospitals.
Generic stat presentation: The stats grid lacks depth and hierarchy. It doesn't tell a story or build immediate trust through visual weight.
Suboptimal CTA hierarchy: The primary goal is WhatsApp booking, but without a unified conversion-focused layout, CTAs might blend in.
Lack of editorial polish: Missing subtle textures, micro-interactions, and appropriate negative space that signals 'expert/specialist'.

typography.strategy: The 'Soft Utility' approach tailored for medical authority.

headings.instruction: Use Google Font 'Outfit'. Use font-light for elegance in sub-headings and font-semibold for primary impact.

body.instruction: Use Google Font 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Maintain high readability with leading-relaxed.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Subtle Roundness, High Contrast.

layout_patterns.hero: Asymmetrical 60/40 split. Left side: Heavy typography, clear trust signals (Apollo badge), primary WhatsApp CTA. Right side: High-quality doctor portrait overlaid on abstract medical background. Do not center everything.
layout_patterns.bento_grid: For 'Meet the Surgeon' and Stats. Use a Tetris-style grid (col-span-full md:col-span-8 etc.) to create visual tension rather than generic equal columns.
layout_patterns.seo_pages: Template must include breadcrumbs, H1 heavily weighted, immediate 2nd paragraph WhatsApp CTA, a sticky table of contents (desktop), and clean hierarchical H2s.

header.desktop: fixed w-full z-50 transition-all duration-300 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200. Left: Brand. Middle: Navigation items (text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900). Right: Primary WhatsApp button.
header.mobile: Sticky top, hamburger menu opens a full-screen or slide-over sheet. Must include quick-dial and WhatsApp links inside the menu.

anti_patterns: NO dark mode variants. Medical UI must remain strictly light, clean, and high-contrast.
NO purple, pink, or neon gradients. If a gradient is needed, use subtle white-to-slate-50.
NO generic centered 3-column layouts. Use asymmetrical bento grids or side-by-side splits.
NO generic Shadcn UI cards. Use the custom component blueprints defined above (HTML + Tailwind classes).
NO native HTML forms. Everything converts via the WhatsApp deep-link CTA.
NO missing hover states. Every interactive element MUST have an explicit hover state.
NO placeholder images. Use ONLY the provided media URLs.

pre_delivery_checklist.accessibility: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Use focus-visible for keyboard navigation rings.
pre_delivery_checklist.motion: Wrap animations with Framer Motion, but respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS queries.
pre_delivery_checklist.responsive: Test explicitly on 375px (budget mobile). Ensure hero loads instantly and doesn't push CTA below the fold.
pre_delivery_checklist.seo: Maintain semantic HTML (nav, section, article, aside). H1 must be the first heading on every page.
